scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run custom-tests && echo 'Done.'
scripts.lint: node ./node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint . --max-warnings=0 && echo '✔  Your code looks good.'
scripts.custom-tests: echo "(No other custom tests yet.)" && echo
scripts.deploy-staging: sails_environment=web_staging npm run bump && sails_environment=web_staging npm run deploy
scripts.deploy-demo: sails_environment=web_demo npm run bump && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy: cp -r eb/bootstrap/$sails_environment.sh .ebbootstrap.sh && echo 'before zip' && npm run zip && echo 'after zip' && rm .ebbootstrap.sh && node scripts/publish-static-assets && echo 'deploying to eb' && node scripts/deploy-to-eb
scripts.deploy-alerts-staging: sails_environment=alerts_staging npm run bump && sails_environment=alerts_staging npm run deploy-alerts
scripts.deploy-alerts: cp eb/bootstrap/$sails_environment.sh .ebbootstrap.sh && cp eb/apps/alerts/cron.yaml cron.yaml && npm run zip-backend && rm cron.yaml .ebbootstrap.sh && node scripts/deploy-to-eb
scripts.deploy-rollup-staging: sails_environment=rollup_staging npm run bump && sails_environment=rollup_staging npm run deploy-rollup
scripts.deploy-rollup: cp eb/bootstrap/$sails_environment.sh .ebbootstrap.sh && cp eb/apps/rollup/cron.yaml cron.yaml && npm run zip-backend && rm cron.yaml .ebbootstrap.sh && node scripts/deploy-to-eb
scripts.deploy-devices-staging: sails_environment=devices_staging npm run bump && sails_environment=devices_staging npm run deploy-devices
scripts.deploy-devices: cp eb/bootstrap/$sails_environment.sh .ebbootstrap.sh && npm run zip-backend && rm .ebbootstrap.sh && node scripts/deploy-to-eb
scripts.deploy-device-sim: cp eb/bootstrap/device_sim.sh .ebbootstrap.sh && cp eb/apps/device-sim/cron.yaml cron.yaml && npm run zip-backend && rm cron.yaml .ebbootstrap.sh && sails_environment=device_sim npm run bump && sails_environment=device_sim node scripts/deploy-to-eb
scripts.deploy-errands-staging: sails_environment=errands_staging npm run bump && sails_environment=errands_staging npm run deploy-errands
scripts.deploy-errands: cp eb/bootstrap/$sails_environment.sh .ebbootstrap.sh && cp eb/apps/errands/cron.yaml cron.yaml && npm run zip-backend && rm cron.yaml .ebbootstrap.sh && node scripts/deploy-to-eb
